module fsm #(
    parameter s0 = 3'b000,
    parameter s1 = 3'b001,
    parameter s2 = 3'b010,
    parameter s3 = 3'b011,
    parameter s4 = 3'b100,
    parameter s5 = 3'b101
) (
    input IN,
    output reg MATCH,
    input CLK,
    input RST
);


reg [2:0] ST_cr, ST_nr;

always @ (*) begin
    if (RST) begin
        ST_nr = s0;
    end else begin
        case (ST_cr)
            s0: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s0;
                end
            end
            
            s1: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s2;
                end
            end
            
            s2: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s3;
                end
            end
            
            s3: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s4;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s0;
                end
            end
            
            s4: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s5;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s2;
                end
            end
            
            s5: begin
                if(IN==1'b1) begin
                    ST_nr = s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_nr = s2;
                end
            end
            
            default: begin
                ST_nr = s0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if(RST) begin
        ST_cr <= s0;
    end else begin
        ST_cr <= ST_nr;
    end
end

assign MATCH = (RST) ? 1'b0 :
               (ST_cr == s4 && IN == 1'b1) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM Detection Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating whether the detected sequence matches.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Define states using local parameters for clarity
        parameter S_INIT = 2'd0;
        parameter S_FIRST_ONE = 2'd1;
        parameter S_SECOND_ZERO = 2'd2;
        parameter S_THIRD_ONE = 2'd3;
        
        // Internal register to hold current state
        reg [1:0] state_reg, next_state;
        reg match_out;
        
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                state_reg <= S_INIT;
                match_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                state_reg <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Next state logic and output generation
        always @(*) begin
            case(state_reg)
                S_INIT: begin
                    match_out = 1'b0;
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S_FIRST_ONE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S_INIT;
                    end
                end
                
                S_FIRST_ONE: begin
                    match_out = 1'b0;
                    if (IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S_SECOND_ZERO;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S_FIRST_ONE;
                    end
                end
                
                S_SECOND_ZERO: begin
                    match_out = 1'b0;
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S_THIRD_ONE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S_INIT;
                    end
                end
                
                S_THIRD_ONE: begin
                    match_out = IN & ~next_state[1]; // Set MATCH to 1 only when IN is 1 and transitioning to S_THIRD_ONE
                    if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S_FIRST_ONE; // Loop back to detect another sequence
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S_INIT;
                    end
                end
                
                default: begin
                    match_out = 1'b0;
                    next_state = S_INIT;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        assign MATCH = match_out;
    </implementation>
</module>
